question: Do repeated exact labels accompany drawings with more similar observable features than different labels matched on section, attributed hand, label kind, frequency, length bin and physical-folio pair?
freeze: Local protocol and code freeze before new visual feature annotation, synthetic calibration and association measurement. Metadata and text availability have been inventoried. This is not external preregistration.
prior_exposure: All source views and former reserves were seen in the atlas. The same assistant has seen earlier observations, repeated-label locus groups, and an f88r transcription excerpt during inventory. Masking cannot erase this exposure. No strict analyst blinding or outside confirmation is claimed.
population: All exact ZL/IT-agreeing single literal alphabetical labels of >=3 EVA characters, same documentary label kind, in sections P/Z/B and known metadata. Retain types repeated on >=2 physical folios within section/attributed-hand/kind. No spelling repair, uncertain-space merge or word meaning. Inventory gives 15 types/35 occurrences before spatial eligibility. Do not select by visual similarity.
identity: A type is exact surface plus section/hand/kind. Frequency is its occurrence count in the complete eligible inventory, fixed before mapping. Length bin = floor(literal EVA length/3). This controls graphic length, not phonemes. ZL/IT agreement is a conservative inclusion rule, not independent confirmation.
attachment: For every inventoried occurrence, record the source image and pixel coordinates, label box, drawing box, object id, geometric evidence, alternatives, and confidence high/uncertain/unresolved. High requires a single geometrically defensible associated motif and a located documentary locus; it does not mean the text names that object. No semantic or shape-similarity argument may choose the attachment. If two objects or source panels remain plausible, exclude from primary and retain both alternatives in the audit. One physical drawing cannot be counted twice as separate evidence. Integrated figure-plus-star motifs are permitted when visibly connected and the association cannot separate their referents; record that scope explicitly.
annotation: Freeze feature definitions first. Prepare exact source crops with opaque white text masks and random occurrence IDs, no EVA strings, paired types or folio labels in the feature cards. Preserve originals, all crop/mask coordinates and hashes; no generated restoration. Inspect every delivered card. Annotate 12 binary observable features per profile with null for unobservable/ambiguous, plus prose description and layout band. Do not fill uncertain features by analogy. Linkage is necessarily text-aware; feature annotation is only partially masked by the same previously exposed operator.
profiles: Plant fragments Lf use PLANT12. Figure/star or nymph motifs Lz/Ln use FIGURE12. Tub/tube Lt use VESSEL12. Profiles and definitions are in FEATURES.json. No pregnancy, species, function, word meaning or language field exists.
units: Occurrence is a located motif, not a crop or glyph. Compare only distinct physical folios. First average multiple occurrence pairs within a type and unordered folio pair, then average folio pairs within a label type, then equally average types within section/hand/kind, then equally average eligible section/hand/kind strata. No individual pair is treated as an independent replicate. A stratum contributes only with >=2 estimable types. Duplicate inscriptions assigned to the same physical motif and same type retain the lexically first locus; conflicting types on one motif are excluded from primary.
similarity: Fraction of agreeing binary features among jointly observed features. Require at least 8 of 12 jointly observed features. Equal feature weights. Unknown never means absent. Shared absences count; their baseline contribution is controlled by the matched different-label comparison and conditional permutations.
contrast: For each type and folio pair, same-label mean similarity minus mean similarity of all different-label pairs on the SAME two folios with exactly one endpoint of that type, and identical section/hand/kind, inventory frequency and length bin. Require both same and different comparisons. Types without matched baselines are reported unestimable. Primary T follows the hierarchical averaging above. Pair counts are descriptive, not sample sizes for an iid test.
null: Permute complete type identities among accepted occurrence positions within page x section x hand x kind x inventory-frequency x length-bin. This exactly preserves page, folio, quire, section, attributed hand, type frequency and type page distribution. Enumerate unique multiset assignments when total <=50000; otherwise use 1999 random assignments plus the observed assignment correction. Recompute the whole contrast each time. Conditioning is an exchangeability assumption, not proof of random historical assignment. Do not infer meaning from p.
coverage_gate: At least 6 estimable label types, 6 physical folios contributing matched contrasts, 2 eligible strata, and >=100 possible unique assignments. If any fail, report descriptive results and exact/randomization references as exploratory only; no positive or negative confirmatory finding.
decision: A limited within-sample association is supported only if calibration and coverage gates pass, T>=0.10 and one-sided p<=0.05, at least 80 percent of estimable leave-one-folio-out contrasts are positive, AND layout-controlled sensitivity has >=100 assignments, positive T and p<=0.05. Otherwise report failure or insufficient support without retuning. Even a pass is not semantic or independent historical validation.
sensitivities: (1) Add recorded layout band (plant row, zodiac ring, or biological vertical third) to permutation blocks and require same band at both ends of each matched comparison class; report loss of support. (2) Include uncertain attachments only when exactly one prespecified alternative is independently geometrically preferred; otherwise retain as unresolved, no best-scoring choice. (3) Leave one whole folio out, recompute contrast without refitting features or thresholds. Do not present these as independent replications.
calibration: 20 synthetic positive datasets with stable label-specific 12-bit features and 5 percent flips; 20 independent-feature nulls; 20 frequency/page-only feature nulls with no label-specific effect. Same scorer and 1999 randomizations, eight folios, two profile strata and fixed metadata. Require >=18/20 positives at T>=.10 and p<=.05, and <=2/20 detections in each null family. Calibration tests arithmetic and this feature-level model, not our object attachment or all visual mechanisms.
independence: An independently written arithmetic implementation and exact small examples verify software only. Frozen visual annotations precede the association calculation. Whole-folio exclusions are internal sensitivity on exposed data. Prepare a separate human-review packet with anonymized masked cards, blank feature forms, definitions and linkage-audit instructions; no human review has happened. A fresh reviewer must submit annotations before opening mappings/results. Historical manuscript blindness cannot be recreated.
preservation: Existing phases 1..24 and atlas stay unchanged. Preserve exclusions, all alternatives, input hashes, frozen code, annotations, controls, insufficient support and negative outcomes. No push, publication or deployment.
